content.text: You are currently viewing Chevrolet.com (United States). Close this window to stay here or choose another country to see vehicles and services specific to your location. Learn About EVs All electric and all about you Whether you’re deciding if an EV is right for you, getting prepared for your new EV, or maintaining your current EV, Chevrolet has you covered. We offer intuitive tools, helpful people standing by to answer your questions, exclusive member benefits, and, of course, the quality and commitment you’ve come to expect from Chevy. Fueled by electricity With easy-to-use available home chargers, you can charge overnight before your morning commute. And with over 250,000 public chargers across North America, nothing seems too far away. Charging Need a hand with installation? Check out Qmerit to get your home charger up and running with ease. Charging Installation Your EV essentials Compare the costs of EV charging alongside traditional gasoline fuel. Compare Use the charging calculator to estimate charge times and costs for your daily driving routine. Calculate Break through the EV myths. Get the facts about range, charging, affordability and more. Explore EV Truths From maintenance to cold weather tips and everyday driving, learn everything about owning an EV. EV Ownership Benefits The pros of EV ownership Say you need your EV in tip-top shape for your upcoming family vacation. We’ll cover your first routine maintenance visit and ensure your EV is ready for the road. Driving an EV could provide potential savings in yearly vehicle maintenance and fuel costs. Fewer moving engine parts means less scheduled maintenance. Covers your battery for 8 years or 100,000 More than 250,000 available chargers Chevrolet is committed to providing easily accessible public charging throughout the U.S. and Canada. Our ever-expanding network now features more DC fast chargers — including Tesla (1) — that are compatible with the standard NACS charge ports. Charge Locator Worth the switch If you’ve ever asked, “Is switching to an EV for me?” Perhaps available tax and utility incentives, less scheduled maintenance, plus the money you save on gas — or lack thereof — can help you decide. Affordability Make your EV your own. Customize settings, stay connected with friends and family, keep track of your favorite places and find new places along the way. Plus, our battery (2) provides outstanding range, performance and tech you’ll want to brag about. Technology With features like Regen on and One Pedal — which convert braking energy into battery energy — you can go your own way, even if it’s the long way. Plus, with our outstanding battery warranty, we’re behind you for miles (say, from Houston to Hackensack). Battery & Range Every ride in a Chevy EV should feel like the ride of your life. Picking up groceries, moving across the country or carrying your DJ equipment to the next gig — our powerful, capable, adaptable EVs are also adventure-ready. Performance Designed with you in mind Our all-electric lineup includes everything you need from the inside out — flexibility, versatility and style. From Bolt to Silverado EV, even you pro ballers out there won’t have to sacrifice looks for leg room.
